operation_type.description: Provide the operation type. Allowed values: Create, Modify. Synonyms must be normalized to the canonical value.
operation_type.x-a2at-value-constraint: Allowed canonical values: Create, Modify. Normalize synonyms to the canonical value instead of treating them as out-of-range: Add / Implement / Establish / Deploy / Set Up / Provision / New / Enable / Activate / Configure are all Create; Update / Adjust / Change / Revise / Edit are all Modify.

task_description.description: Dynamically provide the task description based on the operation type (Create/Modify).
examples: Based on <Task Object> and <Task Context>, output a wireless network energy saving plan that achieves the wireless network energy saving goal defined in <Task Target>, and return the wireless network energy saving result in the format defined in <Expected Output>.
task_description.x-a2at-value-constraint: When the type is [Create]: Based on <Task Object> and <Task Context>, output a wireless network energy saving plan that achieves the wireless network energy saving goal defined in <Task Target>, and return the wireless network energy saving result in the format defined in <Expected Output>. When the type is [Modify]: Based on <Task Object> and <Task Context>, output a wireless network energy saving plan that achieves the wireless network energy saving goal defined in <Task Target>. The value must always be non-null. The <Task Object> and <Task Context> placeholders must be formatted from the values of the task_object and task_context slots respectively.

task_object.description: Explicitly specify the energy saving coverage scope information, a geographic or logical area (e.g., district-level administrative unit). The area information is a required parameter.
examples: The area is the Songshanhu Administration Committee.
task_object.x-a2at-value-constraint: Area name. A named region (a specific region name such as "A2ATestRegion" or "Slice A") is valid. Only anonymous vague descriptions that carry no concrete region name, such as "test area", "sites in this area", "all communities", "indoor communities", or "outdoor communities", must report slot.not_provided. Only one region name is allowed; if the input specifies multiple regions, report slot.constraint_violated.

task_target.description: Define the quantitative or qualitative goals the task must achieve. Quantitative and qualitative goals cannot be selected at the same time, and the default is a qualitative goal.
task_target.x-a2at-value-constraint: 1. Quantitative goal - Energy consumption goal: the gain target of energy saving. The target value format must be a percentage, such as the percentage by which total power consumption is reduced. 2. Qualitative goal - Maximize energy saving under the conditions defined in the task context. The quantitative gain target must be a single specific percentage (e.g. 30%), not a range such as '20%-30%'; a range must report slot.constraint_violated. The qualitative energy-saving mode must be one of: Aggressive Energy Saving (also 'Maximize Energy Saving' or a high GS value), Conservative Energy Saving (also 'Maximize User Experience Assurance' or 'Maximize KPI Assurance'), Lossless Experience Energy Saving, Lossy Experience Energy Saving; any other mode value (e.g. 'green') must report slot.constraint_violated.

task_context.description: Provide the background and context information for task execution.
examples: Cell RAT for energy saving: NR; Energy saving time range: start time "08:00:00", end time "12:00:00"; Time-segmented rate guarantee goal: {00:00~06:00,2Mbps}, {06:00~18:00,10Mbps}.
task_context.x-a2at-value-constraint: 1. Cell radio access technology for energy saving (LTE/NR/LNR/all) 2. The time range for executing energy saving, recurring daily; if omitted, energy saving is performed for the full period, and the rate goal is guaranteed only within the energy saving enabled time range 3. Carrier frequencies that can be turned off during energy saving 4. Rate guarantee goal: the minimum downlink throughput target that must be guaranteed and its effective time period (area-level supports time-segmented/full-period; for time periods without a rate guarantee goal set, experience-lossless energy saving is adopted by default; site-level requires site list, time-segmented rate guarantee goal, and optional background event and duration). Time windows within a time-segmented rate guarantee goal MUST NOT overlap and must fall within the energy-saving execution period; overlapping time windows are a structural violation and MUST be reported as slot.constraint_violated. In the outage/modify scenario, the affected site list (concrete site names, not 'sites in this area' or '10 sites') and the outage start/end time (concrete times, not 'tomorrow' or 'five-hour') are REQUIRED; when either is missing or vague, report slot.not_provided. A rate stated vaguely (e.g. 'maximize the rate' without a concrete number) must report slot.not_provided. When carrier turn-off is requested, concrete frequency points are REQUIRED; report slot.not_provided when missing. 5. The cell radio access technology must be NR / LTE / LNR / all; an invalid value such as '3G' must report slot.constraint_violated. The outage duration must be a single specific number (e.g. 3 hours), not a range such as '2 or 3 hours'; a range must report slot.constraint_violated. A frequency point must be a specific number (e.g. 1600), not an approximation such as 'approximately 1600'; an approximation must report slot.constraint_violated. A time window of a time-segmented rate guarantee goal must be a specific explicit range (e.g. 08:00-12:00); vague time descriptions such as busy / idle / regular / peak / off-peak periods must report slot.constraint_violated.

expected_output.description: When the task object is a geographic/logical area, output the intent report for the network energy saving task.
expected_output.x-a2at-value-constraint: Basic information about the intent execution result: area, intent goal achievement status. Detailed information about the intent execution result: energy saving gain achievement status (current energy saving gain goal, actual energy saving gain percentage, target adjustment suggestions), rate goal achievement status (current rate goal, actual rate, target adjustment suggestions).
